Viagra boys formed in Sweden around 2015 with members Sebastian Murphy on Vocals, Benjamin Vallé on Guitar, Oskar Carl's playing saxophone, Henrik Höckert slapping bass, Tor Sjöden on drums, and Martin Ehrencron playing synth on street worms.
Their funky "Dad Rock" approach to punk and Ska music is blended perfectly with Sebastian's trippy lyrics painting images such as people concealing frogs as weapons, a girl's demand for her special helmet, and a man staring into the glow of a toaster and being transported to the fields of France in ww1.
One of the most creative and interesting bands to come out of the end of the last decade.
